t: Multipurpose wall plugs manufactured from durable nylon. Designed with 4-way expansion which expands in solid building materials, and knots in hollow building materials for maximum hold. Ideal for applications such as attaching cabinets, mirrors, shelves, lighting, wardrobes, letterboxes, TV brackets, bathroom fittings, and electrical fittings.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Brickwork, Stone, Blockwork & Plasterboard
